metadata.description:
A collection of the annual reports & Form 10-K to stockholders of Target Corporation (Ticker: TGT).

The corporation founded in 1902 is an American retail company headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota.  Target stores were established as the discount division of Dayton's department store in 1962 and introduced new stores under the Target brand during the 1990s.  The parent company was renamed in 2000.  The company went public on October 18, 1967 as Dayton Corporation.  

Corporate History & Previous Companies:
  1. Goodfellows Dry Goods (1902-1903)
  2. Dayton's Dry Goods Company (1903-1910)
  3. Dayton Company (1910-1962)
  4. Dayton Corporation (1962-1969)
  5. Dayton-Hudson Corporation (1969-2000)
  6. Target Corporation (2000 - Present)
